source.title: Mundari: The myth of a language without word classes

verified_identity_and_locators.publisher_abstract_scope: The publisher and ANU metadata identify the paper as an analysis of Mundari word-class claims using Hoffmann's corpus and additional data.

rights_access_integrity_boundary.anu_rights_metadata_observed: ANU metadata states that the publisher's version/PDF may be used on an author's personal website, editor's personal website or institutional repository, citing SHERPA/RoMEO as at 24/10/17.
rights_access_integrity_boundary.note: The institutional bitstream endpoint was discoverable and indexed, but direct retrieval through the audit browser returned a 403 during this cycle; therefore no byte/hash or image-level verification is claimed.

deduplication.reason_count_neutral: The cycle verifies and canonicalizes one article work-family but does not yet prove its relationship to any of the 73 unresolved WEB-MUN lead identities.
